about: Decisions a person made on what the catalog build left for review (docs/catalog-review.md), so each build applies them instead of listing them again. A decision only chooses among what the sources say, or says how a source is read; it never adds a value no source gives (docs/catalog-sources.md, "Decisions"). `form`: a cultivar with no page of its own, whose species' sources list it as a tree: the forms it takes, primary first, each listed by a species source. `edible`: a plant a source calls edible that is rated toxic, and whose edible parts and poisonous parts NC State doesn't both name apart (Jason, 2026-10-30: named, with none in both, it's edible without a decision): true writes the source's "edible", with what it lists as poisonous beside it (`poison`), where it lists any; false leaves edible as it was, taking out an older unsourced "yes". A species' decision covers its cultivars (Jason, 2026-10-30). `nativeShown`: a plant the catalog calls exotic that Kew's checklist has native in some states: shown native there all the same. `kewNames`: names Kew's checklist could read two ways, checked to be read as Kew's accepted name, whose authors (`author`) it records. `genusPage`: a plant read from NC State's page for its whole genus, the facts checked to fit it. `split`: a record of several cultivars made one record per cultivar (scripts/catalog/split.mjs): the record keeps its id for one cultivar (`keep`, the one whose size it showed), and each other gets a record of its own, from its own NC State page (`page`) or, with none, names alone, taking its species' size until a source gives its own. An other with `species` is filed by its page under a species Kew keeps apart from its own, and goes under Kew's; one with `botanical` is a plant the record named that isn't one of its cultivars (its genus, or a species), with the page ncsu-pages.json gives it, if any; an entry's `species` is the species record to make where the catalog has none. `cultivar`: a record naming one cultivar beside its species, renamed for it. `rename`: a record renamed by the naming rule where no other kind fits (a seed strain; a record named as its species: Jason, 2026-11-01), its old name kept as a synonym; `soldAs`, the name its sources sell it under, is read as a cultivar's name is, so the build still reads their pages as its own. `kewSpecies`: a cultivar NC State files under a species Kew keeps apart from its own (its page says which it is), put under Kew's species (docs/catalog-sources.md, "Kew's species"). `parent`: a cultivar put under a species its name doesn't give, where its page names it. `fold`: a record whose plants all have records of their own: it goes, and the catalog's `meta.moved` says which record its id stands for from then on (`into`). `group`: a record kept for a group of cultivars, read from its species' page as its own, its size included. `leads`: a fact its sources are far apart on (docs/catalog-review.md, "Sizes whose sources are far apart"): the source that leads it (`source`), the others confirming it or shown as its alternate. `checkOnly`: a source often far off the authorities (docs/catalog-review.md, "Sources often far from the authorities"): what it says goes only to the review, never deciding a value, backing one or shown as its alternate (docs/catalog-sources.md, "A source that's often far off").

vaccinium-virgatum-climax-premier-tifblu.note: Follow Kew: rabbiteye (Vaccinium virgatum) is its own species there; NC State files rabbiteyes under V. corymbosum. The species' name is NC State's for 'Climax' (Rabbiteye blueberry); USDA's (smallflower blueberry) is kept as a synonym.

nepeta-cat-s-meow-walker-s-low.note: No source here names 'Cat's Meow''s species, so it isn't under a species yet.

hemerocallis-happy-returns-spider-types.note: The genus's record reads NC State's genus page; spider daylilies are among those.

crinum-milk-and-wine-bulbispermum.note: Crinum bulbispermum has no NC State page; its facts and name come from its other sources.

leucanthemum-becky.note: Under Shasta daisy once a source names its species.

chaenomeles-double-take-series.note: Under a species once a source names one.

buxus-green-velvet-microphylla-types.note: Littleleaf boxwood is the catalog's record for the microphylla types.

vernonia-hybrid-mt-cuba.note: The earlier list's "Vernonia hybrid (Mt. Cuba)": its one source sells it as Vernonia 'Prairie Princess'. Under a species once a source names one.

asclepias-tuberosa-clay-strain.note: A seed strain, not a cultivar: named by the rule for strains (docs/catalog-format.md, "Names"), its facts kept. Prairie Nursery sells it as Butterfly Weed for Clay. Its botanical name isn't the species' alone, which the app and the build would take for Butterfly milkweed's record.

asparagus-officinalis-jersey-millennium.note: Named as its species, without 'Jersey' or 'Millennium' (Jason: "Rename it to the species."). Its group decision (2026-10-27) went: a record named as its species reads NC State's species page as its own, its size included, without one.

vaccinium-corymbosum-premier.note: NC State's page calls it a rabbiteye cultivar and files it under V. corymbosum; Kew keeps rabbiteye (V. virgatum) apart.

abelia-edward-goucher.note: NC State's page: a hybrid of Abelia × grandiflora and A. schumannii, which it names by the genus alone. It takes Glossy Abelia's facts only where its own page says nothing.

buddleia-davidii-sterile-miss-molly-lo-b.note: The Lo & Behold series have their own records.

pennisetum-alopecuroides-hameln.note: The same plant under its older name.

clematis-jackmanii-viticella-types.note: Clematis viticella has its own record too.

prunus-laurocerasus-caroliniana.note: Prunus caroliniana has its own record too.

salvia-officinalis-origanum-vulgare.note: Oregano has its own record too.

iris-aquatic-spp.note: The earlier list's Water iris, "Iris (aquatic spp.)": several species, no one plant. Blue flag iris, and the other water irises, have records of their own.
